lines.text: And time continues its quiet march.
Freesia is glued to her phone in the car.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Just checking my social media.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Oh wow, everyone's still talking about that mistake I made on the last live stream.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Ugh... these people really blow these things out of proportion!

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: The remark you made at the With Nikke event was a serious mistake, and we're still dealing with the backlash.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Gotta hand it to them. People really love poking their noses in everyone else's business.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: mrsmiss_op_c
lines.text: The speech is coming along nicely, I trust?

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Yeah, it's going great.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss_op_c
lines.text: What about the script?

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: At this point, a quick skim is enough. Who could memorize all that anyway?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss_op_c
lines.text: So, what's the plan for your performance?

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I'm going to cry.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss_op_c
lines.text: Hmm. Smart move.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Like really bawl my eyes out. That should calm things down, right?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss_op_c
lines.text: But don't overdo it. People get tired of seeing the same thing too often.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Of course. Oh, and I told the makeup team to make me look a little worn out.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss_op_c
lines.text: Well, well. Looks like you can manage on your own now.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I couldn't have done it without my amazing producer!

lines.speaker: mrsmiss_op_c
lines.text: You know there's a party after this, right? Make sure to show up and flash that smile of yours.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: So this is all to just butter people up, huh? Count me out, I'm not singing.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss_op_c
lines.text: I'm not making you perform. That performance's worth too much to waste on them for free.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss_op_c
lines.text: See you later, then.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Okay!
*Beep*

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Whew... I'm beat.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... Pretty.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: ... Wait, why'd you call me like that out of nowhere?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Are you doing okay?

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Yeah, sure... but okay about what?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Well, just this and that.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Why do you ask?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: It seems you've changed quite a bit.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I have?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I've gotten used to it. I'm better at handling things now.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I can't let every nasty comment get to me, or even let my emotions run the show.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I'm a celebrity now, the very first Nikke celebrity.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I've got to take things in stride and keep my emotions in check.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Honestly? I think I'm pretty good at that.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... Yeah.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Are you happy now?

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Absolutely,

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I'm so happy I can't believe I didn't do this sooner.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: As long as you're happy, that's all that matters.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Hanson,

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I know I've changed a lot.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: You're just exhausted. You'll feel better soon.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Yeah... it's hard. Really hard.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: But I can't stop.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: No matter how hard it gets,

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I have to keep going.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Otherwise... I'll fall apart.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Why are you pushing yourself so hard?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Maybe things would turn out better if you took it a little easier.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I can't. I've become a symbol.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Pretty is the face of Nikke rights now.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: If I mess up, the Nikkes get blamed.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: If I do well, they're the ones who get praised.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: So I can't take it easy.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: But going full power all the time wears me down.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Right now, putting on a mask is the only way I can keep going.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... Yeah, I can't even begin to imagine how heavy that must feel.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Honestly, it still hasn't quite sunk in for me.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: How are you holding up? Feeling stressed?

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: It's intense... Living a life where everything I do is under watch, and every single action I make can have huge consequences.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: But... once I'm home, I'm fine. I can just be myself.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I see Mr. Oswald has been taking good care of you.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: No. He doesn't say much. He just makes me food, we chat a little, and that's it.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: But even that's such a comfort.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Mister...

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: He doesn't show it openly, but he really cares about what I'm doing.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: He loves the Nikkes as much as I do.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: We're both huge Goddess Squad fans.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Once, he told me...

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: that I'm doing something he never even dared to dream of.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: That makes him happy.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: He says he's proud of me.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: And that's why I can't stop.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I've acted so spoiled with him

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: ever since we first met,

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: and he's never complained once.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: He saved me... He really did.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Living together, he tried so hard

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: to be a good... ugh, I'm going to cry... a good father.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I tried just as hard to be a good daughter too...

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I wasn't always great at it.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: But now, I think I'm doing okay.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I want to be a daughter he can always be proud of.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: That's why I can't stop.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Do you hate me now because I've changed?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Sorry, I was mistaken.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: You haven't changed a bit.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: You're just the same as always.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: ... Thanks.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I think it's about time I got my hands into politics.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Politics?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Isn't being the CEO of one of the Big Three enough?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: No, I'm still under the Central Government's thumb.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Hardly what you could call a real seat of power.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: And just what are you planning to do?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Nothing fancy.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I just want the whole Ark under my control.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Ah, the classic case of ambition ruining people.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: But why now?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Because now's the perfect time to strike.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: And how do you suppose you'd do that?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: By profiting off Pretty.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I'll send Pretty out as the Central Government's PR ambassador.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: They'll be ecstatic. After all, we're putting the Ark's finest propaganda tool right into their hands.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: There'll be some backlash from the public, but only a tiny fraction.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Those who idolize Pretty will follow her blindly.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: They always have. Did you honestly think they ever cared about Nikke rights?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: And in return for handing them Pretty, I take my place in the top echelons of the Central Government.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Then what?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Well... If I manage to break into politics, the first thing I'd do is...

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: I'm talking about Pretty. I couldn't care less about what you're up to.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Same as always. Singing, dancing...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: The only difference is their so-called fight for Nikke rights now just serves the Central Government.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: You really only ever think about yourself.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: At the end of the day, the only thing that matters in life is me.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Living for others? That's just hypocrisy wrapped up as virtue.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Enough. I won't let you throw Pretty away like she's nothing.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: There's a limit to ingratitude.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: You're really going to use the very one who pulled Tetra Line back from hitting rock bottom and then discard her?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Get a grip. You didn't get here because you're exceptional.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: You've been scraping by for so long that now you think you own the whole table.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: What, lost your thrill all of a sudden? Want to get yourself fired?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Pretty still loves to dance and sing. And of course, she loves the Nikkes.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Exactly, that's why I'm letting her keep going.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: If you do that, it won't be the same anymore.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: So what? People change, and she's nothing but scrap metal anyway.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: I'm warning you. Stay away from Pretty.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Don't push your luck. If you've got a problem, the door's that way.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Look at you, acting like some big-shot CEO. You're just a lowly producer.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Now get out.
Mrs. Miss glares at Mustang for a long moment before walking out.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Hmm... Hehe.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: No way.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Uhm...!

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Go to the Central Government? Not a chance!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: Why? Because I've been doing all this for the Nikkes...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You've done enough here. Now it's time to play in bigger waters.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Go to the Central Government. There, wealth and prestige beyond your wildest dreams await.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: A life of entertainment unlike anything you've ever dared to imagine.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: You really think that's what I wanted?

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: And you call yourself the CEO when you're so bad at reading people?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Umph...!

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I'm not going. Not ever.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Oh really?

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Suit yourself. Retire then.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: ... Come again?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I said retire.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Why should I keep wasting money on a worthless hunk of junk that won't listen?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Retire, get out there and do whatever it is you love so much.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: ... But I'm the symbol of all Nikkes.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Then go handle it yourself.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Ready to sign the papers?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I took a worthless nobody and made you a star. And now? You're so arrogant it's insane.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Listen up, rust bucket.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Everything you flaunt around as some shiny symbol of scrap metals? It's all thanks to my money.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: My hand behind every publicity stunt, every fabricated scandal, every crafted image, every record you've ever sold. Who do you think made all that happen?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You think singing and dancing alone would've cut it? You've never been that good at either.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Deep down, you know it was never enough.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: That's why you're keeping your mouth shut.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Refuse my offer, and I'll kick you out and spread every vile rumor I can think of.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Pretty used to despise Nikkes, and the moment she became one, she put on a fake act of repentance just to fool everyone in the Ark.

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: No one in the Ark would fall for a lie like that.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You really think that?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I turned a nobody Nikke into the biggest pop star the Ark has ever seen.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Think I can't take it all away?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You have no idea how many people are just waiting for you to screw up.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Climbing up is hard, but coming down? That's a whole different story.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I could have you on your knees in half a day. Care for a taste?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Relax, I'm just joking. Why so serious?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Fine, two years. Just two years with the Central Government.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: After that, I'll have you back here. No questions, no excuses.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Go ahead, think it over.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: But how long do you need?

lines.speaker: pretty
lines.text: I'll talk to him.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: That bastard... Him again.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Hm...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Fine, have it your way.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Three days. I'll cover you with the sick leave, so use the time wisely.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Now get out of my sight.
Freesia leaves the room.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Mm...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: She still won't break.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Unbelievable.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Drowned in glamour and indulgence... and she's still standing?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Anyone else would've caved by now. Once they fall, I could've molded them however I pleased.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: She's changed, though. Sloppier. Better at putting on an act.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: But her core? Still intact.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Should I tamper with her NIMPH...? No, too dangerous. If I fry her mind, this all becomes worthless.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Huh...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Home.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: No matter what happens, she goes home after every schedule. Like clockwork.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: More than once, I thought I had her. She was right on the edge. Then she goes home and comes back perfectly fine. Every time.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: That's where she's reinforcing herself.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: That old man, Oswald.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: He's the problem.
Mustang opens the safe and flips through the documents containing Oswald's personal information.
The pages are almost entirely redacted, each stamped with "Censored."

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I figured he wasn't just some ordinary guy, so I let him be... But if he tries to get in my way...
Mustang picks up his phone, taps a few buttons,
and the call connects with a beep.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Pick up already! What, stuffed yourself into a stupor again?
*Beep*

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Mustang here.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Nothing serious. Just thought I'd check in.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Haha. Yeah, you can tell, right? I've never been much of a liar.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: ... Anyway, there's someone I need to take care of personally.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I need some info, and he's not exactly your average guy, so I came straight to you.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Yeah, seems like a real big shot.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Hm...

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: As expected, very efficient of you. Appreciate it.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I'll be waiting for your call.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Heh. Isn't life just wonderful?
